examples.chinese: A:你覺得我可以當老師嗎？ B:如果你想當，一定有機會。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ juéde wǒ kěyǐ dāng lǎoshī ma? B: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng dāng, yídìng yǒu jīhuì.
examples.english: A: Do you think I can be a teacher? B: If you want to be one, you'll definitely have a chance.

examples.chinese: 我覺得當記者不容易，週末常常不能休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dāng jìzhě bù róngyì, zhōumò chángcháng bù néng xiūxí.
examples.english: I think being a reporter is not easy; often I can't rest on weekends.

examples.chinese: 在台灣，很多年輕人喜歡當咖啡店的老闆。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, hěn duō niánqīngrén xǐhuān dāng kāfēi diàn de lǎobǎn.
examples.english: In Taiwan, many young people like to be the boss of a coffee shop.

examples.chinese: 他的父母都在學校當老師。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fùmǔ dōu zài xuéxiào dāng lǎoshī.
examples.english: His parents both work as teachers at a school.

examples.chinese: 今天是我第一天上班，當然不能遲到。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ dì yī tiān shàngbān, dāngrán bù néng chídào.
examples.english: Today is my first day at work; of course I can't be late.

examples.chinese: 我是在台灣長大的，當然去過夜市。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì zài Táiwān zhǎngdà de, dāngrán qùguo yèshì.
examples.english: I grew up in Taiwan, so of course I've been to night markets.

examples.chinese: 我買了幾包花蓮當地的名產，要送給台北的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le jǐ bāo Huālián dāngdì de míngchǎn, yào sòng gěi Táiběi de péngyou.
examples.english: I bought several packs of Hualien's local specialties to give to my friends in Taipei.

examples.chinese: 我很喜歡那個房子，看房子當天就跟房東簽約了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān nàge fángzi, kàn fángzi dāngtiān jiù gēn fángdōng qiānyuē le.
examples.english: I really like that house; on the day I viewed it, I signed the contract with the landlord.

examples.chinese: 我買了幾張當地的明信片，這些是這次旅行很好的紀念。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile jǐ zhāng dāngdì de míngxìnpiàn, zhèxiē shì zhè cì lǚxíng hěn hǎo de jìniàn.
examples.english: I bought several local postcards; these are a very good souvenir of this trip.

examples.chinese: 這門課很難，我得用功一點兒，要不然老師可能會當了我。
examples.pinyin: Zhè mén kè hěn nán, wǒ děi yònggōng yīdiǎnr, yàobùrán lǎoshī kěnéng huì dāngle wǒ.
examples.english: This course is very hard; I need to study a bit harder, otherwise the teacher might flunk me.

examples.chinese: 這門課很難，我得用功一點兒，要不然老師可能會被當。
examples.pinyin: Zhè mén kè hěn nán, wǒ děi yònggōng yīdiǎnr, yàobùrán lǎoshī kěnéng huì bèi dāng.
examples.english: This course is very hard; I need to study a bit harder, otherwise the teacher might flunk (me).

examples.chinese: 他的英文、日文都很好，畢業以後想當翻譯。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Yīngwén, Rìwén dōu hěn hǎo, bìyè yǐhòu xiǎng dāng fānyì.
examples.english: His English and Japanese are both very good; after graduation he wants to be a translator.

examples.chinese: 他一直很努力，所以現在當老闆了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīzhí hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ xiànzài dāng lǎobǎn le.
examples.english: He has always made efforts, so now he has become a boss.

examples.chinese: 你得多念一點兒書，將來才有能力當教授。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi duō niàn yīdiǎnr shū, jiānglái cái yǒu nénglì dāng jiàoshòu.
examples.english: You need to study a bit more, so that in the future you will have the ability to be a professor.

examples.chinese: 你得多念一點兒書，將來才有能力當教授。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi duō niàn yīdiǎnr shū, jiānglái cái yǒu nénglì dāng jiàoshòu.
examples.english: You need to study a bit more, so that in the future you will have the ability to be a professor.

examples.chinese: 我收到了健身中心的通知，下個月就要去當健身教練了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shōudào le jiànshēn zhōngxīn de tōngzhī, xià gè yuè jiù yào qù dāng jiànshēn jiàoliàn le.
examples.english: I received a notification from the fitness center; next month I will go be a fitness coach.

examples.chinese: 陳小姐的工作能力很強，難怪可以當老闆的助理。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, nánguài kěyǐ dāng lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ.
examples.english: Miss Chen's work ability is very strong; no wonder she can be the boss's assistant.

examples.chinese: 我答應朋友去KTV幫他過生日，沒想到當天我太忙，忘了這件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dāyìng péngyou qù KTV bāng tā guò shēngrì, méi xiǎngdào dāngtiān wǒ tài máng, wàng le zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: I promised my friend to go to KTV to celebrate his birthday, but I didn't expect that I would be too busy that day and forgot about this matter.

examples.chinese: 愛心服務社社員去安養院陪老人過年，讓老人們感覺相當溫暖。
examples.pinyin: Àixīn fúwùshè shèyuán qù ānyǎngyuàn péi lǎorén guò nián, ràng lǎorénmen gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn.
examples.english: The members of the Love Service Club went to the nursing home to accompany the elderly through the New Year, making the elderly feel quite warm.

examples.chinese: 當寒假一到，大家就準備要過年了。
examples.pinyin: Dāng hánjià yí dào, dàjiā jiù zhǔnbèi yào guò nián le.
examples.english: When the winter vacation arrives, everyone gets ready to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: 老闆很滿意小陳的工作表現， 明年要請他當經理呢！這次的比賽很重要，大家一定要好好地表現。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì Xiǎo Chén de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, míngnián yào qǐng tā dāng jīnglǐ ne! Zhè cì de bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, dàjiā yídìng yào hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The boss is very satisfied with Xiao Chen's work performance and wants to ask him to be the manager next year! This competition is very important; everyone must perform well.

examples.chinese: 我家的客廳當中擺了一套皮沙發。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de kètīng dāngzhōng bǎi le yí tào pí shāfā.
examples.english: In the middle of my living room, a leather sofa set is placed.

examples.chinese: 那個明星很會演戲，演了幾年戲就開始當導演，沒想到第一部戲就成功了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng hěn huì yǎnxì, yǎn le jǐ nián xì jiù kāishǐ dāng dǎoyǎn, méi xiǎngdào dì yī bù xì jiù chénggōng le.
examples.english: That star is very good at acting; after acting for a few years, he started being a director. Unexpectedly, his first film was a success.

examples.chinese: 孔先生學法律，不但是為了當好律師，也是為了保護家人。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānsheng xué fǎlǜ, bùdàn shì wèile dāng hǎo lǜshī, yě shì wèile bǎohù jiārén.
examples.english: Mr. Kong studies law not only to become a good lawyer but also to protect his family.

examples.chinese: 小明從小就很勇敢，希望長大後能當一名好警察。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎomíng cóngxiǎo jiù hěn yǒnggǎn, xīwàng zhǎngdà hòu néng dāng yī míng hǎo jǐngchá.
examples.english: Xiaoming has been brave since childhood, and he hopes that when he grows up he can become a good police officer.

examples.chinese: A:我希望將來能當一名很棒的導演。 B:我相信只要你不斷地努力，就能夢想成真的！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng yī míng hěn bàng de dǎoyǎn. B: Wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào nǐ bùduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de!
examples.english: A: I hope that in the future I can become a great director. B: I believe that as long as you keep working hard, your dreams will come true!

examples.chinese: 為了參加同事的婚禮，我打算當天穿上很有特色的中國傳統服裝。
examples.pinyin: Wèile cānjiā tóngshì de hūnlǐ, wǒ dǎsuàn dāngtiān chuān shàng hěn yǒu tèsè de Zhōngguó chuántǒng fúzhuāng.
examples.english: In order to attend my colleague's wedding, I plan to wear very distinctive traditional Chinese clothing on that day.

examples.chinese: 章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī, jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang has always wanted to be a lawyer. After years of effort, his dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 我舅舅在公司的表現樣樣都好，所以老闆打算明年讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu zài gōngsī de biǎoxiàn yàngyàng dōu hǎo, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn dǎsuàn míngnián ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: My uncle's performance at the company is good in every aspect, so the boss plans to make him manager next year.

examples.chinese:
地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。
當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
examples.pinyin:
Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng.
Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?
examples.english:
During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury.
When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?

examples.chinese: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.
examples.english: This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad.

examples.chinese: 當軍隊一到達災區，就聽到了求救的聲音，所以立刻開始救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Dāng jūnduì yí dàodá zāiqū, jiù tīngdào le qiújiù de shēngyīn, suǒyǐ lìkè kāishǐ jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: As soon as the military arrived at the disaster area, they heard calls for help, so they immediately began disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 小張對世界地理和歷史相當有興趣，為了打開視野，他決定花一年的時間出國旅行。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng duì shìjiè dìlǐ hé lìshǐ xiāngdāng yǒu xìngqù, wèile dǎkāi shìyě, tā juédìng huā yì nián de shíjiān chūguó lǚxíng.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang is quite interested in world geography and history. In order to broaden his vision, he decided to spend a year traveling abroad.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 參加這次總統選舉的人實力都不錯，最後是陳先生當選了。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā zhè cì zǒngtǒng xuǎnjǔ de rén shílì dōu bùcuò, zuìhòu shì Chén xiānsheng dāngxuǎn le.
examples.english: The people who participated in this presidential election all had good qualifications; in the end, Mr. Chen was elected.

examples.chinese: 這次期末考的題目很難，大家的成績都不好，還有幾個人被當了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò kǎo de tímù hěn nán, dàjiā de chéngjì dōu bù hǎo, hái yǒu jǐ ge rén bèi dāng le.
examples.english: The questions on this final exam were very difficult; everyone’s grades were bad, and several people even failed the course.

examples.chinese: 當人們生活水準提高，開始重視生活品質時，休閒活動也就跟著多了起來。
examples.pinyin: Dāng rénmen shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn tígāo, kāishǐ zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí shí, xiūxián huódòng yě jiù gēnzhe duō le qǐlái.
examples.english: When people's standard of living rises and they begin to value quality of life, leisure activities then increase accordingly.

examples.chinese: 出國當交換學生的目的，不僅僅是為了學習語言，更重要的是了解當地的文化。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó dāng jiāohuàn xuéshēng de mùdì, bù jǐnjǐn shì wèile xuéxí yǔyán, gèng zhòngyào de shì liǎojiě dāngdì de wénhuà.
examples.english: The purpose of going abroad as an exchange student is not merely to study a language; more importantly, it is to understand the local culture.

examples.chinese: 那個網路商店經常賣假貨，你可別上當。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wǎnglù shāngdiàn jīngcháng mài jiǎhuò, nǐ kě bié shàngdàng.
examples.english: That online store often sells fake goods; you'd better not be tricked.

examples.chinese:
你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。
下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。
昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin:
Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le.
Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé.
Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english:
The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends.
After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam.
Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.
examples.english: Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries.

examples.chinese: 當我遇到挫折時，他總是協助我克服困難，我們之間也建立了珍貴的友誼。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ yùdào cuòzhé shí, tā zǒngshì xiézhù wǒ kèfú kùnnán, wǒmen zhījiān yě jiànlì le zhēnguì de yǒuyì.
examples.english: When I encounter setbacks, he always helps me overcome difficulties, and we have also established a precious friendship between us.

examples.chinese: 林阿姨來我家推銷保險，我不好意思當面拒絕她，只好假裝有急事要出門。
examples.pinyin: Lín āyí lái wǒ jiā tuīxiāo bǎoxiǎn, wǒ bù hǎoyìsi dāngmiàn jùjué tā, zhǐhǎo jiǎzhuāng yǒu jíshì yào chūmén.
examples.english: Auntie Lin came to my house to sell insurance; I was too embarrassed to refuse her in person, so I had no choice but to pretend I had an urgent matter and had to go out.

examples.chinese:
學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。
聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin:
Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí.
Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english:
Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria.
Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 每當包太太心情不好的時候，包先生就會說笑話來逗她，讓她開心一點。
examples.pinyin: Měidāng Bāo tàitai xīnqíng bù hǎo de shíhou, Bāo xiānsheng jiù huì shuō xiàohua lái dòu tā, ràng tā kāixīn yìdiǎn.
examples.english: Whenever Mrs. Bao is in a bad mood, Mr. Bao will tell jokes to tease her and make her a little happier.

examples.chinese: 這兩個國家因為搶石油資源，而把對方當成了敵人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā yīnwèi qiǎng shíyóu zīyuán, ér bǎ duìfāng dāngchéng le dírén.
examples.english: These two countries, because they are fighting over oil resources, have regarded each other as enemies.

examples.chinese: 杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。
examples.pinyin: Dù xiānsheng shì sān jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de zhǔguǎn, tā xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng dà qǐyè de lǎobǎn, yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Mr. Du is the manager of three online stores; he hopes that in the future he can become the boss of a big enterprise and have his own career.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 連先生很年輕的時候就當了國小校長，當年他才三十歲。
examples.pinyin: Lián xiānsheng hěn niánqīng de shíhou jiù dāng le guóxiǎo xiàozhǎng, dāngnián tā cái sānshí suì.
examples.english: Mr. Lian became an elementary school principal when he was very young; in those days he was only thirty years old.

examples.chinese: 畢業當天，許多學生帶著攝影機在校園裡攝影，留下了珍貴的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè dāngtiān, xǔduō xuéshēng dài zhe shèyǐngjī zài xiàoyuán lǐ shèyǐng, liú xià le zhēnguì de huíyì.
examples.english: On graduation day, many students brought cameras and took pictures on campus, leaving behind precious memories.

examples.chinese:
想當年，出國留學的日子雖然很忙，卻很充實。
算算日子，剩下兩個星期經理就要退休了。
明天是我父母結婚三十年的重要日子，一定要好好地慶祝。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎng dāngnián, chūguó liúxué de rìzi suīrán hěn máng, què hěn chōngshí.
Suàn suàn rìzi, shèngxià liǎng ge xīngqī jīnglǐ jiù yào tuìxiū le.
Míngtiān shì wǒ fùmǔ jiéhūn sānshí nián de zhòngyào rìzi, yídìng yào hǎohǎo de qìngzhù.
examples.english:
Thinking back to those days, although the days of studying abroad were busy, they were very fulfilling.
Counting the days, there are only two weeks left before the manager retires.
Tomorrow is the important day of my parents' thirtieth wedding anniversary; we must celebrate it well.

examples.chinese: 易先生對戲劇有很大的興趣，小時候的夢想就是當一名成功的演員。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng duì xìjù yǒu hěn dà de xìngqù, xiǎoshíhou de mèngxiǎng jiùshì dāng yì míng chénggōng de yǎnyuán.
examples.english: Mr. Yi has a great interest in drama; his childhood dream was to become a successful actor.

examples.chinese: 姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie yǒu le zìjǐ de háizi yǐhòu, cái tǐhuì dào dāng fùmǔ shì hěn xīnkǔ de.
examples.english: Only after having her own child did my older sister realize that being a parent is very hard.

examples.chinese: 上次我出國旅行時，護照被偷了，幸好導遊通知了當地的外交人員，很快就辦好了新護照。
examples.pinyin: Shàngcì wǒ chūguó lǚxíng shí, hùzhào bèi tōu le, xìngkuī dǎoyóu tōngzhī le dāngdì de wàijiāo rényuán, hěn kuài jiù bàn hǎo le xīn hùzhào.
examples.english: Last time I traveled abroad, my passport was stolen; fortunately, the tour guide notified the local diplomatic personnel, and a new passport was quickly issued.

examples.chinese: A:你說老闆下個月要提高每個人的薪水，沒騙我吧？ B:這個消息是從他的口中說出來的，當然是真的。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō lǎobǎn xià gè yuè yào tígāo měi gè rén de xīnshuǐ, méi piàn wǒ ba? B: Zhège xiāoxi shì cóng tā de kǒu zhōng shuō chūlái de, dāngrán shì zhēn de.
examples.english: A: You said the boss is going to raise everyone's salary next month—you're not fooling me, are you? B: This news came out of his own mouth; of course it's true.

examples.chinese: 小安有一張娃娃臉，到哪裡都被當作大學生，誰知道他已經四十歲了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān yǒu yì zhāng wáwa liǎn, dào nǎlǐ dōu bèi dàngzuò dàxuéshēng, shéi zhīdào tā yǐjīng sìshí suì le.
examples.english: Xiao An has a baby face, so wherever he goes he is treated as a university student; who would know he is already forty years old.

examples.chinese: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.
examples.english: That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel.

examples.chinese: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 隔壁家的小子相當懂事，附近的鄰居們都很喜歡他。
examples.pinyin: Gébì jiā de xiǎozi xiāngdāng dǒngshì, fùjìn de línjūmen dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
examples.english: The young fellow next door is quite sensible; the neighbors nearby all like him very much.

examples.chinese: 臺北當地的夜市有很多好吃的宵夜，改天我帶你去嘗嘗。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi dāngdì de yèshì yǒu hěn duō hǎochī de xiāoyè, gǎitiān wǒ dài nǐ qù chángchang.
examples.english: The local night markets in Taipei have many delicious late-night snacks; another day I'll take you to try them.

examples.chinese: 我心中有兩個夢想，一是當歌星，另一個是去各國旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīn zhōng yǒu liǎng ge mèngxiǎng, yī shì dāng gēxīng, lìng yí ge shì qù gè guó lǚxíng.
examples.english: I have two dreams in my heart: one is to become a singer, and the other is to travel to various countries.

examples.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián yóuyú shìzhǎng jījí shíxíng jiāotōng jiànshè jìhuà, shǐ dāngdì jiāotōng qíngkuàng míngxiǎn gǎishàn le.
examples.english: In recent years, because the mayor actively implemented a transportation construction plan, the local traffic situation has obviously improved.

examples.chinese: 天哪！這次期末考真不容易呀，要是考不好被當了，怎麼辦哪？
examples.pinyin: Tiān na! Zhè cì qīmòkǎo zhēn bù róngyì ya, yàoshì kǎo bù hǎo bèi dāng le, zěnme bàn na?
examples.english: Oh my! This final exam is really not easy—if I don't do well and get flunked, what will I do?

examples.chinese: 如果你想到菲律賓旅行，還是帶著美金到當地換錢比較方便。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng dào Fēilǜbīn lǚxíng, háishì dàizhe měijīn dào dāngdì huànqián bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
examples.english: If you want to travel to the Philippines, it's more convenient to bring US dollars and exchange money locally.

examples.chinese: 他曾替公司談成了三億美元的生意，因此老闆讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Tā céng tì gōngsī tán chéng le sān yì měiyuán de shēngyì, yīncǐ lǎobǎn ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: He once negotiated a three-hundred-million-dollar deal for the company, so the boss made him manager.

examples.chinese: 那位服裝設計師相當喜愛十八世紀時的歐洲傳統風格。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúzhuāng shèjìshī xiāngdāng xǐ'ài shíbā shìjì shí de Ōuzhōu chuántǒng fēnggé.
examples.english: That fashion designer quite loves the traditional European style of the 18th century.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣鐵路局的網站訂票，一人最多只能訂六張搭車當天的票。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān Tiělùjú de wǎngzhàn dìng piào, yī rén zuìduō zhǐ néng dìng liù zhāng dā chē dāngtiān de piào.
examples.english: When booking tickets on the Taiwan Railways Administration website, each person can book at most six tickets for the day of travel.

examples.chinese: 當你急著需要某個物品時，不管划不划算，都非買不可。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ jízhe xūyào mǒu gè wùpǐn shí, bùguǎn huá bù huásuàn, dōu fēi mǎi bùkě.
examples.english: When you urgently need a certain item, regardless of whether it is cost-effective or not, you simply must buy it.

examples.chinese: 我想出國當背包客，除了能打開視野，並能訓練自己更獨立。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chūguó dāng bēibāokè, chúle néng dǎkāi shìyě, bìng néng xùnliàn zìjǐ gèng dúlì.
examples.english: I want to go abroad as a backpacker; besides being able to broaden my horizons, and also train myself to be more independent.

examples.chinese: 他每次出國，都會幫朋友代購許多具有當地特色的商品。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi cì chūguó, dōu huì bāng péngyǒu dàigòu xǔduō jùyǒu dāngdì tèsè de shāngpǐn.
examples.english: Every time he goes abroad, he buys on behalf of friends many products with local characteristics.

examples.chinese: 青少年期的心理變化相當大，需要父母及老師多關心。
examples.pinyin: Qīngshàonián qī de xīnlǐ biànhuà xiāngdāng dà, xūyào fùmǔ jí lǎoshī duō guānxīn.
examples.english: During the adolescent period, psychological changes are quite large, and parents and teachers need to care more.

examples.chinese: 在歐洲，小麥做的各種食品常被當作餐桌上的主要食物。
examples.pinyin: Zài Ōuzhōu, xiǎomài zuò de gè zhǒng shípǐn cháng bèi dàngzuò cānzhuō shàng de zhǔyào shíwù.
examples.english: In Europe, various foods made from wheat are often regarded as the main food on the dining table.

examples.chinese: 當周圍環境很靜的時候，可以聽見平常聽不到的聲音。
examples.pinyin: Dāng zhōuwéi huánjìng hěn jìng de shíhou, kěyǐ tīngjiàn píngcháng tīng bù dào de shēngyīn.
examples.english: When the surrounding environment is very quiet, you can hear sounds that you normally cannot hear.

examples.chinese: 上個星期我去鄉下旅行，當地人非常好客。
examples.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqī wǒ qù xiāngxià lǚxíng, dāngdìrén fēicháng hàokè.
examples.english: Last week I traveled to the countryside; the local people were very hospitable.

examples.chinese: 她做的籃子很漂亮，很多人買來當作禮物。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò de lánzi hěn piàoliang, hěn duō rén mǎi lái dàngzuò lǐwù.
examples.english: The baskets she makes are very pretty; many people buy them as gifts.

examples.chinese: 台灣有句著名的廣告台詞「心動不如馬上行動」，意思是當個人有了想法之後，光是想是沒用的，得立刻行動才行。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu jù zhùmíng de guǎnggào táicí “xīndòng bùrú mǎshàng xíngdòng”, yìsi shì dāng gèrén yǒu le xiǎngfǎ zhīhòu, guāng shì xiǎng shì méiyòng de, děi lìkè xíngdòng cái xíng.
examples.english: Taiwan has a famous advertising slogan, “Acting immediately is better than just being moved.” It means that after a person has an idea, merely thinking about it is useless; one must take action immediately.

examples.chinese: 露營最開心的就是當營火(campfire)燃燒時，大家在營火周圍又唱又跳。
examples.pinyin: Lùyíng zuì kāixīn de jiùshì dāng yínghuǒ ránshāo shí, dàjiā zài yínghuǒ zhōuwéi yòu chàng yòu tiào.
examples.english: The happiest part of camping is when the campfire is burning, everyone sings and dances around the campfire.

examples.chinese: 他的夢想是利用水來當作交通工具的燃料，可是很多人認為不可能。
examples.pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng shì lìyòng shuǐ lái dāngzuò jiāotōng gōngjù de ránliào, kěshì hěn duō rén rènwéi bù kěnéng.
examples.english: His dream is to use water as fuel for transportation vehicles, but many people think it is impossible.

examples.chinese: 那個眼鏡的金屬材料相當特別，因此價格比一般眼鏡貴三成。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge yǎnjìng de jīnshǔ cáiliào xiāngdāng tèbié, yīncǐ jiàgé bǐ yībān yǎnjìng guì sān chéng.
examples.english: The metal material of those glasses is quite special, so the price is thirty percent more expensive than ordinary glasses.

examples.chinese: 當掉進海裡的小孩被救上來時，大家都激動地歡呼了起來。
examples.pinyin: Dāng diào jìn hǎi lǐ de xiǎohái bèi jiù shànglái shí, dàjiā dōu jīdòng de huānhū le qǐlái.
examples.english: When the child who had fallen into the sea was rescued, everyone excitedly cheered.

examples.chinese: 當別人表現得很好時，別忘了為他們鼓掌，給他們鼓勵。
examples.pinyin: Dāng biérén biǎoxiàn de hěn hǎo shí, bié wàngle wèi tāmen gǔzhǎng, gěi tāmen gǔlì.
examples.english: When others perform well, don't forget to applaud for them and give them encouragement.

examples.chinese: 學校邀請李教授來演講，內容相當精彩，讓我有很大的收穫。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào yāoqǐng Lǐ jiàoshòu lái yǎnjiǎng, nèiróng xiāngdāng jīngcǎi, ràng wǒ yǒu hěn dà de shōuhuò.
examples.english: The school invited Professor Li to give a lecture; the content was quite wonderful, which gave me a great harvest.

examples.chinese: 樂團主唱的唱歌技巧，對樂團演出表現的影響相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yuètuán zhǔchàng de chànggē jìqiǎo, duì yuètuán yǎnchū biǎoxiàn de yǐngxiǎng xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: The lead vocalist's singing skills have a considerable impact on the band's performance.

examples.chinese: 每次當我回憶起大學的社團生活，就會想到那一群知心好友。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dāng wǒ huíyì qǐ dàxué de shètuán shēnghuó, jiù huì xiǎngdào nà yī qún zhīxīn hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: Every time I recall my university club life, I think of that group of close friends.

examples.chinese: 當聽到周博士多年的研究終於有了成果時，所有員工都給他最大的掌聲。
examples.pinyin: Dāng tīngdào Zhōu bóshì duōnián de yánjiū zhōngyú yǒu le chéngguǒ shí, suǒyǒu yuángōng dōu gěi tā zuì dà de zhǎngshēng.
examples.english: When they heard that Dr. Zhou's years of research had finally produced results, all the employees gave him the biggest applause.

examples.chinese: 如果從事某項工作能令你忘掉時間，或許就可當作一生的事業。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ cóngshì mǒu xiàng gōngzuò néng lìng nǐ wàngdiào shíjiān, huòxǔ jiù kě dàngzuò yīshēng de shìyè.
examples.english: If being engaged in a certain job can make you forget time, perhaps it can be treated as a lifelong career.

examples.chinese: 那家中式點心店的紅豆沙包子又香又甜，我時常買來當作早餐。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā zhōngshì diǎnxīn diàn de hóngdòushā bāozi yòu xiāng yòu tián, wǒ shícháng mǎi lái dàngzuò zǎocān.
examples.english: The red bean paste buns at that Chinese dim sum shop are both fragrant and sweet; I often buy them for breakfast.

examples.chinese: 這條街道旁有各式各樣的商店與餐廳，假日時相當熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào páng yǒu gèshìgèyàng de shāngdiàn yǔ cāntīng, jiàrì shí xiāngdāng rènao.
examples.english: Along this street there are all kinds of shops and restaurants; on holidays it is quite bustling.

examples.chinese: 當你心裡覺得難受的時候，可以跟好朋友聊聊。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ xīnlǐ juéde nánshòu de shíhou, kěyǐ gēn hǎo péngyou liáoliao.
examples.english: When you feel upset inside, you can chat with a good friend.

examples.chinese: 我對人體各部分的功能很有興趣，不過我沒想過當醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì réntǐ gè bùfèn de gōngnéng hěn yǒu xìngqù, bùguò wǒ méi xiǎngguò dāng yīshēng.
examples.english: I'm very interested in the functions of the various parts of the human body, but I've never thought about becoming a doctor.

examples.chinese: 小王追求祝小姐好幾年了，不過祝小姐一直只把她當好友。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng zhuīqiú Zhù xiǎojiě hǎo jǐ nián le, búguò Zhù xiǎojiě yìzhí zhǐ bǎ tā dāng hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: Xiao Wang has been pursuing Miss Zhu for several years, but Miss Zhu has always only regarded him as a good friend.

examples.chinese: 錢先生買了一只上百萬的鑽石戒指，當成跟女友求婚的禮物。
examples.pinyin: Qián xiānsheng mǎi le yì zhī shàng bǎi wàn de zuànshí jièzhǐ, dāngchéng gēn nǚyǒu qiúhūn de lǐwù.
examples.english: Mr. Qian bought a diamond ring worth over a million, considering it a gift to propose to his girlfriend.

examples.chinese: 露營時我沒帶枕頭，只好把背包當作枕頭，睡起來挺不舒服的。
examples.pinyin: Lùyíng shí wǒ méi dài zhěntou, zhǐhǎo bǎ bēibāo dàngzuò zhěntou, shuì qǐlái tǐng bù shūfu de.
examples.english: When camping, I didn't bring a pillow, so I had to use my backpack as a pillow; sleeping was quite uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 他的中文能力已達到相當好的水準，在臺灣念研究所沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén nénglì yǐ dádào xiāngdāng hǎo de shuǐzhǔn, zài Táiwān niàn yánjiūsuǒ méi wèntí.
examples.english: His Chinese ability has already reached a fairly good level; studying at a graduate school in Taiwan is no problem.

examples.chinese: 從小時候起，他的第一志願就是當一位保護國家的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xiǎoshíhou qǐ, tā de dì-yī zhìyuàn jiùshì dāng yī wèi bǎohù guójiā de jūnrén.
examples.english: Since childhood, his first aspiration has been to be a soldier who protects the country.

examples.chinese: 在指導演員的表達方式上，這位導演的經驗相當豐富。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhǐdǎo yǎnyuán de biǎodá fāngshì shàng, zhè wèi dǎoyǎn de jīngyàn xiāngdāng fēngfù.
examples.english: In guiding actors' ways of expression, this director's experience is quite rich.

examples.chinese: 如果想當語言教師，得先考取教師證書，將來找工作較順利。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dāng yǔyán jiàoshī, děi xiān kǎoqǔ jiàoshī zhèngshū, jiānglái zhǎo gōngzuò jiào shùnlì.
examples.english: If you want to be a language teacher, you must first pass the exam to obtain a teaching certificate; then finding a job in the future will be smoother.

examples.chinese: 當你面臨困難或挑戰時，也正是表現個人智慧與能力的最佳時刻。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ miànlín kùnnán huò tiǎozhàn shí, yě zhèng shì biǎoxiàn gèrén zhìhuì yǔ nénglì de zuì jiā shíkè.
examples.english: When you face difficulties or challenges, it is also exactly the best moment to demonstrate personal wisdom and ability.

examples.chinese: 每次當我們在學習華語上遇到困難，老師總是耐心地教導大家。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dāng wǒmen zài xuéxí Huáyǔ shàng yùdào kùnnán, lǎoshī zǒngshì nàixīn de jiàodǎo dàjiā.
examples.english: Every time we encounter difficulties in learning Chinese, the teacher always patiently teaches everyone.

examples.chinese: 我逛街時經過了一排小吃攤，就買幾樣回來當作宵夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ guàngjiē shí jīngguò le yì pái xiǎochītān, jiù mǎi jǐ yàng huílái dàngzuò xiāoyè.
examples.english: When I was shopping, I passed a row of food stalls and bought a few items to bring back as a late-night snack.

examples.chinese: 小王的閱讀報告寫得很精彩，連教授都在課堂上當面誇獎他。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng de yuèdú bàogào xiě de hěn jīngcǎi, lián jiàoshòu dōu zài kètáng shàng dāngmiàn kuājiǎng tā.
examples.english: Xiao Wang's reading report was written wonderfully; even the professor praised him to his face in class.

examples.chinese: 當父母的總是希望子女將來能有成就，過著幸福的日子。
examples.pinyin: Dāng fùmǔ de zǒngshì xīwàng zǐnǚ jiānglái néng yǒu chéngjiù, guòzhe xìngfú de rìzi.
examples.english: Parents always hope their children will have achievements in the future and live happy days.

examples.chinese: 一小部分人引起的戰爭使人民付出了相當大的代價。
examples.pinyin: Yī xiǎo bùfèn rén yǐnqǐ de zhànzhēng shǐ rénmín fùchū le xiāngdāng dà de dàijià.
examples.english: The war caused by a small group of people made the people pay a considerable price.

examples.chinese: 他來臺灣主要是想了解當地風俗，此外也想學習一點兒華語。
examples.pinyin: Tā lái Táiwān zhǔyào shì xiǎng liǎojiě dāngdì fēngsú, cǐwài yě xiǎng xuéxí yīdiǎnr Huáyǔ.
examples.english: He came to Taiwan mainly to understand local customs; in addition, he also wants to learn a little Chinese.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了嚴重的流行病，使人民受到相當大的生活壓力。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le yánzhòng de liúxíngbìng, shǐ rénmín shòudào xiāngdāng dà de shēnghuó yālì.
examples.english: A serious epidemic broke out in the Asian region, causing people to receive considerable life pressure.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了戰爭，使人民生活上所受的的壓力相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le zhànzhēng, shǐ rénmín shēnghuó shàng suǒ shòu de yālì xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: War broke out in the Asian region, causing the pressure that people received in life to be considerable.

examples.chinese: 他相當迷那位明星，因此不管穿的用的都模仿他。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiāngdāng mí nà wèi míngxīng, yīncǐ bùguǎn chuān de yòng de dōu mófǎng tā.
examples.english: He is quite obsessed with that star, so regardless of what he wears or uses, he imitates him.

examples.chinese: 他去當環保志工是為了保護自然環境，也是為了培養耐心。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù dāng huánbǎo zhìgōng shì wèile bǎohù zìrán huánjìng, yě shì wèile péiyǎng nàixīn.
examples.english: He went to be an environmental volunteer in order to protect the natural environment, and also to cultivate patience.

examples.chinese: 他的頭部被棒球打中並當場昏迷，還好幾分鐘後就醒過來了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tóubù bèi bàngqiú dǎ zhòng bìng dāngchǎng hūnmí, háihǎo jǐ fēnzhōng hòu jiù xǐng guòlái le.
examples.english: He was hit in the head by a baseball and lost consciousness on the spot; fortunately, he woke up after a few minutes.

examples.chinese: 張小姐很膽小，看到車禍現場有人流了很多血，當場就昏倒了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě hěn dǎnxiǎo, kàn dào chēhuò xiànchǎng yǒu rén liú le hěn duō xiě, dāngchǎng jiù hūndǎo le.
examples.english: Miss Zhang is very timid; when she saw someone bleeding a lot at the car accident scene, she fainted on the spot.

examples.chinese: 當外科醫生不容易，不僅要有手術的專業能力，體力也得夠好。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wàikē yīshēng bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào yǒu shǒushù de zhuānyè nénglì, tǐlì yě děi gòu hǎo.
examples.english: Being a surgery doctor is not easy; you not only need professional surgical skills, but your physical strength also has to be good enough.

examples.chinese: 當我聽到被公司錄取的消息時，還以為是做夢，忍不住用力捏了自己一下。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ tīngdào bèi gōngsī lùqǔ de xiāoxi shí, hái yǐwéi shì zuòmèng, rěnbuzhù yònglì niēle zìjǐ yīxià.
examples.english: When I heard the news that I was hired by the company, I still thought I was dreaming, and I couldn't help but pinch myself hard.

examples.chinese: 當別人遇到不愉快的事時，應該避免說些刺激他的話。
examples.pinyin: Dāng biérén yùdào bù yúkuài de shì shí, yīnggāi bìmiǎn shuō xiē cìjī tā de huà.
examples.english: When others encounter unpleasant things, one should avoid saying things that irritate them.

examples.chinese: 想小便的時候千萬別忍耐，否則對健康的影響相當大。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng xiǎobiàn de shíhou qiānwàn bié rěnnài, fǒuzé duì jiànkāng de yǐngxiǎng xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: When you need to urinate, never hold it in, otherwise the impact on your health is considerable.

examples.chinese: 當我難過的時候，最需要的是家人與好友的安慰。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ nánguò de shíhòu, zuì xūyào de shì jiārén yǔ hǎoyǒu de ānwèi.
examples.english: When I am sad, what I need most is the comfort of family and good friends.

examples.chinese: 王媽媽一直把媳婦當作自己的女兒，當他們家的媳婦真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wáng māma yīzhí bǎ xífù dàngzuò zìjǐ de nǚ'ér, dāng tāmen jiā de xífù zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang has always treated her daughter-in-law as her own daughter; being their family's daughter-in-law is truly blessed.

examples.chinese: 戴小姐的父母對婚禮相當重視，連喜帖都是他們親自設計的。
examples.pinyin: Dài xiǎojiě de fùmǔ duì hūnlǐ xiāngdāng zhòngshì, lián xǐtiě dōu shì tāmen qīnzì shèjì de.
examples.english: Miss Dai's parents place great importance on the wedding; even the wedding invitations were designed by them personally.

examples.chinese: 他順利當上那家大飯店的廚師後，好多朋友都打電話祝賀他。
examples.pinyin: Tā shùnlì dāngshàng nà jiā dà fàndiàn de chúshī hòu, hǎoduō péngyǒu dōu dǎ diànhuà zhùhè tā.
examples.english: After he successfully became a chef at that big hotel, many friends called to congratulate him.

examples.chinese: 那只鑽石戒指的設計極有特色，很適合當作婚戒(wedding ring)。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī zuànshí jièzhǐ de shèjì jí yǒu tèsè, hěn shìhé dāngzuò hūnjiè.
examples.english: The design of that diamond ring is extremely distinctive; it is very suitable to serve as a wedding ring.

examples.chinese: 鵝一看到陌生人就會大叫，所以鄉村裡有人把鵝當成狗來看家(kānjiā， to guard the house)。
examples.pinyin: É yī kàndào mòshēngrén jiù huì dàjiào, suǒyǐ xiāngcūn lǐ yǒu rén bǎ é dāngchéng gǒu lái kānjiā.
examples.english: As soon as a goose sees a stranger, it will honk loudly, so in the countryside some people treat geese like dogs to guard the house.

examples.chinese: A:那所大學雖然相當著名，但我國政府不承認他們的學位(academic degree)。B:許多國家都承認那所大學的學位，貴國哪裡有不承認的道理？
examples.pinyin: A: Nà suǒ dàxué suīrán xiāngdāng zhùmíng, dàn wǒguó zhèngfǔ bù chéngrèn tāmen de xuéwèi. B: Xǔduō guójiā dōu chéngrèn nà suǒ dàxué de xuéwèi, guìguó nǎlǐ yǒu bù chéngrèn de dàolǐ?
examples.english: A: Although that university is quite famous, our government does not recognize their academic degrees. B: Many countries recognize that university's degrees—how could your esteemed country have any reason not to recognize them?

examples.chinese: 小周找到理想工作後，女友特地送了一條領帶當作禮物，還親手為他打領帶，祝賀他有個好的開始。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu zhǎodào lǐxiǎng gōngzuò hòu, nǚyǒu tèdì sòng le yī tiáo lǐngdài dāngzuò lǐwù, hái qīnshǒu wèi tā dǎ lǐngdài, zhùhè tā yǒu gè hǎo de kāishǐ.
examples.english: After Xiao Zhou found his ideal job, his girlfriend specially gave him a necktie as a gift, and even personally tied the necktie for him, congratulating him on a good start.

examples.chinese: 他想寫一本以各行各業人物當作題材的長篇小說。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng xiě yī běn yǐ gègèhánggèyè rénwù dāngzuò tícái de chángpiān xiǎoshuō.
examples.english: He wants to write a full-length novel that uses people from all walks of life as its subject matter.

examples.chinese: 當你大學畢業，不再升學時，就得考慮就業問題了。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ dàxué bìyè, bù zài shēngxué shí, jiù děi kǎolǜ jiùyè wèntí le.
examples.english: When you graduate from university and are no longer pursuing further studies, you then have to consider the issue of employment.

examples.chinese: 這對夫婦打扮得相當講究，讓我對他們從事的行業很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì fūfù dǎbàn de xiāngdāng jiǎngjiū, ràng wǒ duì tāmen cóngshì de hángyè hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: This couple dresses quite elegantly, which makes me very interested in the profession they are engaged in.

examples.chinese: 我們特地到當地的滑雪用品工廠參觀，並進行技術交流。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen tèdì dào dāngdì de huáxuě yòngpǐn gōngchǎng cānguān, bìng jìnxíng jìshù jiāoliú.
examples.english: We specially visited a local ski equipment factory and conducted technical exchanges.

examples.chinese: 想當節目主持人，具有好口才是最基本的條件。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng dāng jiémù zhǔchírén, jùyǒu hǎo kǒucái shì zuì jīběn de tiáojiàn.
examples.english: If you want to be a program host, having good eloquence is the most basic requirement.

examples.chinese: 有些學校將教育當成商品來買賣，但也有人不支持。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē xuéxiào jiāng jiàoyù dàngchéng shāngpǐn lái mǎimài, dàn yě yǒu rén bù zhīchí.
examples.english: Some schools treat education as a commodity to buy and sell, but there are also people who do not support this.

examples.chinese: 學校安排我們到鄉下當「一日農民」，體驗農夫的辛苦。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào ānpái wǒmen dào xiāngxià dāng “yī rì nóngmín”, tǐyàn nóngfū de xīnkǔ.
examples.english: The school arranged for us to go to the countryside to be a 'farmer for a day' and experience the hardships of farmers.

examples.chinese: 紀念郵票一般都是以歷史上的大事或重要人物當作主題。
examples.pinyin: Jìniàn yóupiào yībān dōu shì yǐ lìshǐ shàng de dàshì huò zhòngyào rénwù dàngzuò zhǔtí.
examples.english: Commemorative stamps generally use major historical events or important figures as their themes.

examples.chinese: 他對亞洲文化相當有興趣，計畫將來走遍全亞洲。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì Yàzhōu wénhuà xiāngdāng yǒu xìngqù, jìhuà jiānglái zǒu biàn quán Yàzhōu.
examples.english: He is quite interested in Asian culture and plans to travel all over Asia in the future.

examples.chinese: 想導演一部以蟲子當作主角的電影，真不是件容易的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng dǎoyǎn yī bù yǐ chóngzi dàngzuò zhǔjiǎo de diànyǐng, zhēn bù shì jiàn róngyì de shì.
examples.english: Wanting to direct a movie with insects as the main characters is really not an easy thing.

examples.chinese: 我與高中同學已十多年沒見了，想找個適當時間邀請大家聚聚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǔ gāozhōng tóngxué yǐ shí duō nián méi jiàn le, xiǎng zhǎo ge shìdàng shíjiān yāoqǐng dàjiā jù ju.
examples.english: I haven't seen my high school classmates for over ten years; I want to find an appropriate time to invite everyone to get together.

examples.chinese: 當你願意開放自己的心時， 你所見的世界也會更加地美妙。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ yuànyì kāifàng zìjǐ de xīn shí, nǐ suǒ jiàn de shìjiè yě huì gèngjiā de měimiào.
examples.english: When you are willing to open your heart, the world you see will also become even more wonderful.

examples.chinese: 臺灣企業到發展中國家設立工廠，是因為當地的人工便宜。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān qǐyè dào fāzhǎnzhōng guójiā shèlì gōngchǎng, shì yīnwèi dāngdì de réngōng piányi.
examples.english: Taiwanese enterprises set up factories in developing countries because local labor is cheap.

examples.chinese: 隨著科技進步，醫學也不斷前進，當醫師的人得多充實自己。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì jìnbù, yīxué yě bùduàn qiánjìn, dāng yīshī de rén děi duō chōngshí zìjǐ.
examples.english: With technological progress, medicine also continuously advances; those who become doctors must enrich themselves a lot.

examples.chinese: 當森林漸漸從地球上消失時，可能使全球氣候產生重大的變化。
examples.pinyin: Dāng sēnlín jiànjiàn cóng dìqiú shàng xiāoshī shí, kěnéng shǐ quánqiú qìhòu chǎnshēng zhòngdà de biànhuà.
examples.english: When forests gradually disappear from the Earth, it may cause major changes in the global climate.

examples.chinese: 這件事我根本不了解，所以沒辦法給你適當的建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ gēnběn bù liǎojiě, suǒyǐ méi bànfǎ gěi nǐ shìdàng de jiànyì.
examples.english: I simply don't understand this matter at all, so I have no way to give you appropriate advice.

examples.chinese: 他初到臺灣時，十分不適應當地的氣候。
examples.pinyin: Tā chū dào Táiwān shí, shífēn bù shìyìng dāngdì de qìhòu.
examples.english: When he first arrived in Taiwan, he was quite unaccustomed to the local climate.

examples.chinese: 他是華僑，說中文時常帶點兒當地的口音。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì huáqiáo, shuō Zhōngwén shí cháng dài diǎnr dāngdì de kǒuyīn.
examples.english: He is an overseas Chinese; when he speaks Chinese, he often has a bit of a local accent.

examples.chinese: 工作有壓力時，應適當地分配你的工作及娛樂時間。
examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò yǒu yālì shí, yīng shìdàng de fēnpèi nǐ de gōngzuò jí yúlè shíjiān.
examples.english: When work is stressful, you should appropriately allocate your work and leisure time.

examples.chinese: 那位模特兒曾多次參與連續劇演出，相當受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mótèér céng duō cì cānyù liánxùjù yǎnchū, xiāngdāng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: That model has participated in TV drama performances many times and is quite popular.

examples.chinese: 不知道是什麼緣故，每次當我見到你時，總是覺得很歡喜。
examples.pinyin: Bù zhīdào shì shénme yuángù, měi cì dāng wǒ jiàn dào nǐ shí, zǒngshì juéde hěn huānxǐ.
examples.english: I don't know what the reason is, but every time I see you, I always feel very happy.

examples.chinese: 中國古代的人們相信，當好人碰到危險或困難時，會有神仙到人間來幫助他們。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài de rénmen xiāngxìn, dāng hǎorén pèng dào wēixiǎn huò kùnnán shí, huì yǒu shénxiān dào rénjiān lái bāngzhù tāmen.
examples.english: People in ancient China believed that when good people encountered danger or difficulties, immortals would come to the human world to help them.

examples.chinese: 小戴在這場籃球比賽中表現相當優秀，投中了三十多分，因此被教練選中，代表學校參加全國比賽。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎodài zài zhè chǎng lánqiú bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn xiāngdāng yōuxiù, tóu zhòng le sānshí duō fēn, yīncǐ bèi jiàoliàn xuǎn zhòng, dàibiǎo xuéxiào cānjiā quánguó bǐsài.
examples.english: Xiaodai performed quite excellently in this basketball game, hitting over thirty points, and was therefore selected by the coach to represent the school in the national competition.

examples.chinese: 在戶外的夜景中攝影，以月光當作背景可增加神秘的感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zài hùwài de yèjǐng zhōng shèyǐng, yǐ yuèguāng dāngzuò bèijǐng kě zēngjiā shénmì de gǎnjué.
examples.english: When photographing outdoor night scenes, using moonlight as the background can add a mysterious feeling.

examples.chinese: 在人生地不熟的地方旅行時，如有當地人帶路，就可以節省不少時間。
examples.pinyin: Zài rénshēngdìbùshú de dìfāng lǚxíng shí, rú yǒu dāngdìrén dàilù, jiù kěyǐ jiéshěng bùshǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: When traveling in a place where you are unfamiliar with the people and surroundings, if a local leads the way, you can save quite a bit of time.

examples.chinese: 當室內與戶外溫度的差別很大時，我就容易感冒。
examples.pinyin: Dāng shìnèi yǔ hùwài wēndù de chābié hěn dà shí, wǒ jiù róngyì gǎnmào.
examples.english: When the difference between indoor and outdoor temperatures is large, I easily catch a cold.

examples.chinese: 這幅設計圖畫得很仔細，畫圖的人應該相當細心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú shèjì tú huà de hěn zǐxì, huà tú de rén yīnggāi xiāngdāng xìxīn.
examples.english: This design drawing is drawn very carefully; the person who drew it must be quite meticulous.

examples.chinese: 傳統私立高中有許多規定，在管理學生方面相當嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Chuántǒng sīlì gāozhōng yǒu xǔduō guīdìng, zài guǎnlǐ xuéshēng fāngmiàn xiāngdāng yángé.
examples.english: Traditional private high schools have many rules and are quite strict in terms of managing students.

examples.chinese: 當我們爬上那座高山，看見美麗的日出時，大家都驚訝地張大了嘴巴。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒmen pá shàng nà zuò gāo shān, kànjiàn měilì de rìchū shí, dàjiā dōu jīngyà de zhāng dà le zuǐbā.
examples.english: When we climbed up that high mountain and saw the beautiful sunrise, everyone opened their mouths wide in surprise.

examples.chinese: 要前往國外旅行，得先確認當地現在的氣候，好收拾行李。
examples.pinyin: Yào qiánwǎng guówài lǚxíng, děi xiān quèrèn dāngdì xiànzài de qìhòu, hǎo shōushí xínglǐ.
examples.english: To go abroad for travel, you must first confirm the local current climate so as to pack your luggage.

examples.chinese: 這位記者專門報導社會新聞，他報新聞的方式相當專業。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jìzhě zhuānmén bàodǎo shèhuì xīnwén, tā bào xīnwén de fāngshì xiāngdāng zhuānyè.
examples.english: This reporter specializes in reporting social news; the way he reports news is quite professional.

examples.chinese: 李博士在國際上相當有名，他的研究總能引發學者討論。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ bóshì zài guójì shàng xiāngdāng yǒumíng, tā de yánjiū zǒng néng yǐnfā xuézhě tǎolùn.
examples.english: Dr. Li is quite famous internationally; his research always sparks discussions among scholars.

examples.chinese: 在抗議新建工廠的活動中，當地的環保團體聯合起來表達他們的需求。
examples.pinyin: Zài kàngyì xīn jiàn gōngchǎng de huódòng zhōng, dāngdì de huánbǎo tuántǐ liánhé qǐlái biǎodá tāmen de xūqiú.
examples.english: In the protest against the construction of a new factory, local environmental groups united to express their demands.

examples.chinese: 這面金牌是完全用金子做的，外觀也相當獨特。
examples.pinyin: Zhè miàn jīnpái shì wánquán yòng jīnzi zuò de, wàiguān yě xiāngdāng dútè.
examples.english: This gold medal is made entirely of gold, and its appearance is also quite unique.

examples.chinese: 這臺食品加工設備的構造相當複雜，其中約三分之一的零件還是由國外進口。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái shípǐn jiāgōng shèbèi de gòuzào xiāngdāng fùzá, qízhōng yuē sān fēn zhī yī de língjiàn hái shì yóu guówài jìnkǒu.
examples.english: The structure of this food processing equipment is quite complex, and about one third of its parts are still imported from abroad.

examples.chinese: 我記得有羊、馬、兔子……，最特別的是龍。（打開課本）妳看看……
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìdé yǒu yáng, mǎ, tùzi..., zuì tèbié de shì lóng. (dǎkāi kèběn) Nǐ kànkan...
examples.english: I remember there are goats, horses, rabbits..., and the most special one is the dragon. (Open the textbook) You see...

examples.chinese: 我們要過馬路，到對面去坐公車。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào guò mǎlù, dào duìmiàn qù zuò gōngchē.
examples.english: We need to cross the road to go to the opposite side to take the bus.

examples.chinese: 我問了他一個問題，他馬上就回答了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wèn le tā yí ge wèntí, tā mǎshàng jiù huídá le.
examples.english: I asked him a question, and he answered immediately.

examples.chinese: 小馬先用手機把要賣的商品全部都拍了下來，再放到網路上賣，一個星期就賣完了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ xiān yòng shǒujī bǎ yào mài de shāngpǐn quánbù dōu pāi le xiàlái, zài fàng dào wǎnglù shàng mài, yī ge xīngqī jiù mài wán le.
examples.english: Xiao Ma first used his cell phone to photograph all the products he wanted to sell, then put them online to sell, and they were sold out in a week.

examples.chinese: 我室友的生活習慣很差，我已經忍耐他很久了，真希望他馬上搬走。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shìyǒu de shēnghuó xíguàn hěn chà, wǒ yǐjīng rěnnài tā hěn jiǔ le, zhēn xīwàng tā mǎshàng bān zǒu.
examples.english: My roommate's living habits are very bad; I have tolerated him for a long time, and I really hope he moves out immediately.

examples.chinese: 雖然小馬的個子不高，不過籃球打得可好了。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Xiǎo Mǎ de gèzi bù gāo, bùguò lánqiú dǎ de kě hǎo le.
examples.english: Although Xiao Ma's build is not tall, he plays basketball really well.

examples.chinese:
我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。
A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá.
A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english:
I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately.
A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

examples.chinese: A:醫生，我求你快救救我的貓。 B:別急！我馬上檢查。
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng, wǒ qiú nǐ kuài jiùjiu wǒ de māo. B: Bié jí! Wǒ mǎshàng jiǎnchá.
examples.english: A: Doctor, I beg you to save my cat quickly. B: Don't worry! I'll examine it right away.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài dà mǎlù páng, cóng zǎo dào wǎn zàoyīn bùduàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng le shēnghuó pǐnzhí, suǒyǐ juédìng bānjiā.
examples.english: My home is next to a major road, and there is constant noise from morning till night, which has seriously affected our quality of life, so we decided to move.

examples.chinese: 在王小姐的部落格裡，除了有她的旅遊日記，還有在非洲大草原騎馬的相片。
examples.pinyin: Zài Wáng xiǎojiě de bùluògé lǐ, chúle yǒu tā de lǚyóu rìjì, hái yǒu zài Fēizhōu dà cǎoyuán qí mǎ de xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: In Miss Wang's blog, besides her travel diary, there are also photos of horseback riding on the African savanna.

examples.chinese: 這條馬路高低不平，為了避免發生意外，開車經過時一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo mǎlù gāodī bù píng, wèile bìmiǎn fāshēng yìwài, kāichē jīngguò shí yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This road is uneven (high and low, not flat); in order to avoid accidents, you must be careful when driving through.

examples.chinese: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Mǎ xiǎojiě zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò de yuányīn bùshì zìjǐ de tiáojiàn bù gòu hǎo, shì tā tài quēfá zìxìn le.
examples.english: I think the reason Miss Ma can't find a job is not that her own qualifications aren't good enough, but that she lacks self-confidence too much.

examples.chinese: 小馬做事又負責又認真，答應別人的事情也一定會做到，是個很可靠的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ zuòshì yòu fùzé yòu rènzhēn, dāying biérén de shìqíng yě yīdìng huì zuòdào, shì gè hěn kěkào de rén.
examples.english: Xiao Ma is both responsible and serious in doing things, and he will definitely do what he promises others; he is a very reliable person.

examples.chinese:
我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。
費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái.
Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english:
Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it.
Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 便利商店不遠，從我家過去只要五分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn bù yuǎn, cóng wǒ jiā guòqù zhǐyào wǔ fēnzhōng.
examples.english: The convenience store is not far; going over from my home takes only five minutes.

examples.chinese: 小王手裡提著那麼多東西，好像很重，我們過去幫他提一些吧！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shǒu lǐ tízhe nàme duō dōngxi, hǎoxiàng hěn zhòng, wǒmen guòqù bāng tā tí yīxiē ba!
examples.english: Xiao Wang is carrying so many things in his hands; they look heavy. Let's go over and help him carry some!

examples.chinese: 他參加了服務社團的活動後，生活比過去更豐富、更有意義。
examples.pinyin: Tā cānjiā le fúwù shètuán de huódòng hòu, shēnghuó bǐ guòqù gèng fēngfù, gèng yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: After he participated in the service club's activities, his life has become richer and more meaningful than in the past.

examples.chinese:
公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。
地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin:
Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng.
Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english:
The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it.
Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese:
每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。
導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin:
Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù.
Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english:
Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing.
The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 那輛腳踏車對個子小的我來說太高了，腳很難跨過去。我們大學前年起已開放跨校選課，增加各校的交流機會。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng jiǎotàchē duì gèzi xiǎo de wǒ lái shuō tài gāo le, jiǎo hěn nán kuà guòqù. Wǒmen dàxué qiánnián qǐ yǐ kāifàng kuàxiào xuǎnkè, zēngjiā gè xiào de jiāoliú jīhuì.
examples.english: That bicycle is too high for me, since I'm short, so it's hard to straddle my leg over it. Our university has offered cross-school course selection since the year before last, increasing opportunities for exchange between schools.

examples.chinese: 如果說能回到過去，我最想放下工作，追求自己的興趣。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒshuō néng huídào guòqù, wǒ zuì xiǎng fàngxià gōngzuò, zhuīqiú zìjǐ de xìngqù.
examples.english: If I could return to the past, I would most want to set aside work and pursue my own interests.

examples.chinese: 有些事忍耐一下就過去了，什麼都想以吵架的方式解決，遲早會出事的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì rěnnài yīxià jiù guòqù le, shénme dōu xiǎng yǐ chǎojià de fāngshì jiějué, chízǎo huì chūshì de.
examples.english: Some things pass after enduring them for a bit; if you want to solve everything by arguing, sooner or later there will be an accident.

examples.chinese: 人生短短幾十年，一輩子很快就過去了，因此應該活得精彩、過得有意義。
examples.pinyin: Rénshēng duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yībèizi hěn kuài jiù guòqù le, yīncǐ yīnggāi huó de jīngcǎi, guò de yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: Life is only a short few decades; a lifetime passes quickly, so one should live splendidly and meaningfully.

examples.chinese: 從過去到現在，尊敬長輩一直是華人最重視的傳統觀念之一。
examples.pinyin: Cóng guòqù dào xiànzài, zūnjìng zhǎngbèi yīzhí shì Huárén zuì zhòngshì de chuántǒng guānniàn zhī yī.
examples.english: From the past to the present, respecting elders has always been one of the traditional values that Chinese people value most.

examples.chinese: 我剛拖了地，地上還是溼的，你最好繞過去比較安全。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng tuō le dì, dìshàng háishì shī de, nǐ zuìhǎo rào guòqù bǐjiào ānquán.
examples.english: I just mopped the floor, and the floor is still wet; you'd better go around it, it's safer.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，小感冒只要多喝水、多休息就行了，不需要看病、吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, xiǎo gǎnmào zhǐyào duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi jiù xíng le, bù xūyào kànbìng, chī yào.
examples.english: Generally speaking, for a minor cold, you just need to drink more water and rest more; you don't need to see a doctor or take medicine.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，父母在孩子的心中是最偉大的，沒有人可以取代。
examples.pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, fùmǔ zài háizi de xīnzhōng shì zuì wěidà de, méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qǔdài.
examples.english: Generally speaking, parents are the greatest in their children's hearts; no one can replace them.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，面試時要準備的相關文件包括個人基本資料、畢業證書等等。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, miànshì shí yào zhǔnbèi de xiāngguān wénjiàn bāokuò gèrén jīběn zīliào, bìyè zhèngshū děngděng.
examples.english: Generally speaking, the relevant documents to prepare for an interview include basic personal information, graduation certificate, and so on.

examples.chinese: 有一些口罩正面跟反面的差異很小，不過一般來說，正面的顏色較深，反面的顏色較淺。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē kǒuzhào zhèngmiàn gēn fǎnmiàn de chāyì hěn xiǎo, bùguò yībān lái shuō, zhèngmiàn de yánsè jiào shēn, fǎnmiàn de yánsè jiào qiǎn.
examples.english: For some masks, the difference between the front side and the reverse side is very small, but generally speaking, the front side is darker in color and the reverse side is lighter.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，到舞廳跳舞的多數是年輕人。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, dào wǔtīng tiàowǔ de duōshù shì niánqīngrén.
examples.english: Generally speaking, most of those who go to the dance hall to dance are young people.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，參加正式活動都得好好打扮，服裝也應該講究。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, cānjiā zhèngshì huódòng dōu děi hǎohǎo dǎbàn, fúzhuāng yě yīnggāi jiǎngjiu.
examples.english: Generally speaking, to attend formal events one must dress up properly, and clothing should also be carefully chosen.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，手工做的麵包比機器做的好吃。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, shǒugōng zuò de miànbāo bǐ jīqì zuò de hǎochī.
examples.english: Generally speaking, handmade bread tastes better than machine-made bread.

items.wordHook: Taking 一(one) general 般(sort) of observation to 來(arrive) and 說(speak): 一般來說 means generally speaking.

examples.chinese: 佳佳認為談戀愛的對象，年齡不重要，容不容易溝通、個性適不適合才是最重要的。
examples.pinyin: Jiājiā rènwéi tán liàn'ài de duìxiàng, niánlíng bù zhòngyào, róng bù róngyì gōutōng, gèxìng shì bù shìhé cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Jiajia believes that for a romantic partner, age is not important; whether it is easy to communicate with them and whether their personality suits you are the most important things.

examples.chinese: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough.

examples.chinese: 有一些交友網站上的個人姓名、年齡等資料都是假的，所以上網交友要小心。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē jiāoyǒu wǎngzhàn shàng de gèrén xìngmíng, niánlíng děng zīliào dōu shì jiǎ de, suǒyǐ shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: Some personal information such as names and ages on dating websites is false, so you need to be careful when making friends online.

examples.chinese: 阿里山上的樹木又高又粗，好幾棵樹木的年齡都超過一千年了。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān shàng de shùmù yòu gāo yòu cū, hǎojǐ kē shùmù de niánlíng dōu chāoguò yīqiān nián le.
examples.english: The trees on Alishan are both tall and thick; several of them are over a thousand years old.

examples.chinese: 我的白髮隨著年齡越來越多了，我想找一天去染頭髮。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de báifà suízhe niánlíng yuèláiyuè duō le, wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī tiān qù rǎn tóufa.
examples.english: My white hairs are increasing with age; I want to find a day to go dye my hair.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，上網訂好火車票後，可選擇到車站或便利商店取票。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, shàngwǎng dìng hǎo huǒchē piào hòu, kě xuǎnzé dào chēzhàn huò biànlì shāngdiàn qǔ piào.
examples.english: In Taiwan, after booking train tickets online, you can choose to pick up the tickets at the station or at a convenience store.

examples.chinese: 前天我收到大學的來信，才知道我被錄取了，真開心。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān wǒ shōudào dàxué de láixìn, cái zhīdào wǒ bèi lùqǔ le, zhēn kāixīn.
examples.english: The day before yesterday I received an incoming letter from the university, and only then did I learn that I had been admitted; I'm really happy.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，父母在孩子的心中是最偉大的，沒有人可以取代。
examples.pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, fùmǔ zài háizi de xīnzhōng shì zuì wěidà de, méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qǔdài.
examples.english: Generally speaking, parents are the greatest in their children's hearts; no one can replace them.

examples.chinese: 那所非常有名的大學每年只錄取一千名新生，除了得成績夠好，還需要一點兒運氣才進得去。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ fēicháng yǒumíng de dàxué měi nián zhǐ lùqǔ yīqiān míng xīnshēng, chúle děi chéngjì gòu hǎo, hái xūyào yīdiǎnr yùnqi cái jìn de qù.
examples.english: That very famous university only admits one thousand new students each year; besides needing good enough grades, you also need a bit of luck to get in.

examples.chinese: 這場大型戶外活動因為租不到合適的地方，就被取消了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dàxíng hùwài huódòng yīnwèi zū bú dào héshì de dìfāng, jiù bèi qǔxiāo le.
examples.english: This large outdoor event was canceled because a suitable place couldn't be rented.

examples.chinese: 如果想當語言教師，得先考取教師證書，將來找工作較順利。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dāng yǔyán jiàoshī, děi xiān kǎoqǔ jiàoshī zhèngshū, jiānglái zhǎo gōngzuò jiào shùnlì.
examples.english: If you want to be a language teacher, you must first pass the exam to obtain a teaching certificate; then finding a job in the future will be smoother.

examples.chinese: 當我聽到被公司錄取的消息時，還以為是做夢，忍不住用力捏了自己一下。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ tīngdào bèi gōngsī lùqǔ de xiāoxi shí, hái yǐwéi shì zuòmèng, rěnbuzhù yònglì niēle zìjǐ yīxià.
examples.english: When I heard the news that I was hired by the company, I still thought I was dreaming, and I couldn't help but pinch myself hard.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有不小心發生錯誤的時候，不需要取笑別人。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng cuòwù de shíhou, bù xūyào qǔxiào biérén.
examples.english: Everyone has times when they accidentally make mistakes; there is no need to make fun of others.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，有人說夏天開冷氣不如開除溼機，不過有專家表示，它們的功能無法互相取代。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, yǒu rén shuō xiàtiān kāi lěngqì bùrú kāi chúshījī, bùguò yǒu zhuānjiā biǎoshì, tāmen de gōngnéng wúfǎ hùxiāng qǔdài.
examples.english: In Taiwan, some people say that in summer, turning on the air conditioner is not as good as turning on a dehumidifier, but some experts say that their functions cannot replace each other.

examples.chinese: 主管的責任之一是幫員工爭取更好的福利。
examples.pinyin: Zhǔguǎn de zérèn zhī yī shì bāng yuángōng zhēngqǔ gèng hǎo de fúlì.
examples.english: One of the supervisor's responsibilities is to fight for better benefits for the employees.

items.wordHook: A captive's torn 耳(ear) is seized firmly in a victor's 又(hand) as spoils to claim and 取(take).

examples.chinese: 在路上撿到錢包可以交給警察，請他們幫忙處理。
examples.pinyin: Zài lùshang jiǎn dào qiánbāo kěyǐ jiāo gěi jǐngchá, qǐng tāmen bāngmáng chǔlǐ.
examples.english: If you pick up a wallet on the street, you can hand it over to the police and ask them to help handle it.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風雨大風又強，大街上不少店家都關店休息。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǔ dà fēng yòu qiáng, dàjiē shang bùshǎo diànjiā dōu guān diàn xiūxi.
examples.english: This typhoon brought heavy rain and strong winds; on the main street, many shops closed to rest.

examples.chinese: 人類大腦分成幾區，有的管語言，有的管記憶，很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi dànǎo fēnchéng jǐ qū, yǒude guǎn yǔyán, yǒude guǎn jìyì, hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: The human brain is divided into several areas; some manage language, some manage memory—it's very interesting.

examples.chinese: 路教授最近發表的這套跟人體大腦有關的理論，令其他科學家很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zuìjìn fābiǎo de zhè tào gēn réntǐ dànǎo yǒuguān de lǐlùn, lìng qítā kēxuéjiā hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: This set of theories related to the human brain recently published by Professor Lu has made other scientists very interested.

examples.chinese: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.
examples.english: That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

examples.chinese: 因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiángliè táifēng de guānxì, jīchǎng yǐjīng guān le, děng fēng xiǎo yīdiǎn cái huì zài kāifàng.
examples.english: Because of the strong typhoon, the airport has already closed; it will open again only after the wind gets a little weaker.

examples.chinese: 這座地下停車場因為缺乏經費，沒辦法改善又暗又溼的情形。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dìxià tíngchēchǎng yīnwèi quēfá jīngfèi, méi bànfǎ gǎishàn yòu àn yòu shī de qíngxíng.
examples.english: Because this underground parking lot lacks funds, there is no way to improve its dark and damp condition.

examples.chinese:
為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。
像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin:
Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān.
Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english:
In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries.
Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 那棟公寓自從三年前的一場大火之後，就不適合居住了。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng gōngyù zìcóng sān nián qián de yī chǎng dàhuǒ zhīhòu, jiù bù shìhé jūzhù le.
examples.english: Since a big fire three years ago, that apartment building has not been suitable for residing in.

examples.chinese: 一大早就有不少民眾在寺廟前的廣場上運動。
examples.pinyin: Yī dàzǎo jiù yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng zài sìmiào qián de guǎngchǎng shàng yùndòng.
examples.english: Early in the morning, quite a few people are already exercising in the square in front of the temple.

examples.chinese: 學校蓋了一棟活動中心，學生又多了一個交流、休閒的好場所了。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào gài le yī dòng huódòng zhōngxīn, xuéshēng yòu duō le yī gè jiāoliú, xiūxián de hǎo chǎngsuǒ le.
examples.english: The school has built an activity center; the students now have one more good place for interaction and leisure.

examples.chinese: 公園附近的停車場還很空，你可以把車停到那裡去。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán fùjìn de tíngchēchǎng hái hěn kōng, nǐ kěyǐ bǎ chē tíng dào nàlǐ qù.
examples.english: The parking lot near the park is still very empty; you can park your car there.

examples.chinese: 紀先生的部落格擁有不少讀者，下個週末他要辦一場新書活動，買了新書的讀者都可以請他簽名。
examples.pinyin: Jì xiānsheng de bùluògé yōngyǒu bùshǎo dúzhě, xià gè zhōumò tā yào bàn yī chǎng xīnshū huódòng, mǎi le xīnshū de dúzhě dōu kěyǐ qǐng tā qiānmíng.
examples.english: Mr. Ji's blog has quite a few readers; next weekend he will hold a new book event, and readers who have bought the new book can ask him for an autograph.

examples.chinese: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.
examples.english: Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上一醒來就去刷牙、洗臉，然後去附近國小的操場跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang yì xǐnglái jiù qù shuāyá, xǐliǎn, ránhòu qù fùjìn guóxiǎo de cāochǎng pǎobù.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as I wake up, I go brush my teeth and wash my face, and then I go running on the playground of the nearby elementary school.

examples.chinese: 易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng cóng zhíchǎng tuìxiū hòu, jiù jiārù le yīyuàn de fúwù shètuán, jìxù wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.
examples.english: After Mr. Yi retired from the workplace, he joined the hospital's service club and continued to contribute his part to society.

examples.chinese:
那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。
總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin:
Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá.
Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english:
That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather.
Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 在那場車禍中，那個孩子失去了父母，家裡只剩下他一個人，大家都很同情他。
examples.pinyin: Zài nà chǎng chēhuò zhōng, nàge háizi shīqù le fùmǔ, jiālǐ zhǐ shèng xià tā yī ge rén, dàjiā dōu hěn tóngqíng tā.
examples.english: In that car accident, that child lost his parents, and he was the only one left in the family; everyone sympathized with him.

examples.chinese: 金先生最近遇到了很不幸的事，他的父母在一場交通意外中去世了。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiānsheng zuìjìn yùdàole hěn búxìng de shì, tā de fùmǔ zài yì chǎng jiāotōng yìwài zhōng qùshì le.
examples.english: Mr. Jin recently encountered a very unfortunate event: his parents died in a traffic accident.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 為了符合市場的需求，「快時尚」公司不斷地設計出最流行的服裝樣式。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fúhé shìchǎng de xūqiú, “kuài shíshàng” gōngsī búduàn de shèjì chū zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng yàngshì.
examples.english: In order to be in accord with market demand, “fast fashion” companies continuously design the most popular clothing styles.

examples.chinese:
黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。
這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin:
Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng.
Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english:
Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise.
This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 好幾個人都看到他跟這場火災有關，他不但不承認，反而說是鄰居做的。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo jǐ ge rén dōu kàndào tā gēn zhè chǎng huǒzāi yǒuguān, tā búdàn bù chéngrèn, fǎn'ér shuō shì línjū zuò de.
examples.english: Several people saw that he was connected to this fire; not only did he not admit it, but instead he said the neighbor did it.

examples.chinese: 上次出國時，到了機場才發現沒帶護照，這次我絕對不會再忘了。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì chūguó shí, dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn méi dài hùzhào, zhè cì wǒ juéduì bù huì zài wàng le.
examples.english: Last time I went abroad, I only discovered at the airport that I hadn't brought my passport; this time I absolutely will not forget again.

examples.chinese: 市場為了改善兒童和青少年的生活品質，而增加了球場、游泳池等休閒場所。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng wèile gǎishàn értóng hé qīngshàonián de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, ér zēngjiā le qiúchǎng, yóuyǒngchí děng xiūxián chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: In order to improve the quality of life for children and teenagers, the market added leisure places such as ball courts and swimming pools.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩在這場大地震中失去了親人，實在太可憐了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái zài zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn zhōng shīqù le qīnrén, shízài tài kělián le.
examples.english: That child lost his family in this big earthquake; it's really too pitiful.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese:
我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。
那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne.
Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english:
When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought.
That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese:
因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。
這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin:
Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō.
Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english:
Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast.
There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese: 何小姐習慣去傳統市場買水果，而且都跟同一個攤販買。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě xíguàn qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ, érqiě dōu gēn tóng yí ge tānfàn mǎi.
examples.english: Miss He is used to buying fruit at the traditional market, and she always buys from the same street vendor.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 這個週末有一場演唱會，你要不要跟我一起去看？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò yǒu yī chǎng yǎnchànghuì, nǐ yào bu yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù kàn?
examples.english: This weekend there is a concert, do you want to go watch it with me?

examples.chinese: 媽媽告訴我，不要忘記去超級市場買飲料。
examples.pinyin: Māma gàosu wǒ, bùyào wàngjì qù chāojí shìchǎng mǎi yǐnliào.
examples.english: Mom told me not to forget to go to the supermarket to buy drinks.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽的花店在百貨公司和超級市場中間。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma de huādiàn zài bǎihuò gōngsī hé chāojí shìchǎng zhōngjiān.
examples.english: My mother's flower shop is between the department store and the supermarket.

examples.chinese: 我明天早上九點要到機場。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn yào dào jīchǎng.
examples.english: I need to arrive at the airport at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 我要到超級市場去買蛋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào dào chāojí shìchǎng qù mǎi dàn.
examples.english: I want to go to the supermarket to buy eggs.

examples.chinese: 從我家到機場也不遠，開車去、坐捷運去都可以。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào jīchǎng yě bù yuǎn, kāichē qù, zuò jiéyùn qù dōu kěyǐ.
examples.english: It is not far from my house to the airport. I can go by car or MRT.

examples.chinese: 機場附近的風景也很漂亮，我常常去看風景、看飛機。
examples.pinyin: Jīchǎng fùjìn de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliang, wǒ chángcháng qù kàn fēngjǐng, kàn fēijī.
examples.english: The scenery near the airport is beautiful; I often go there to see the view and watch the planes.

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

examples.chinese: 我跟他的個性、想法都合得來，就是飲食習慣合不來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā de gèxìng, xiǎngfǎ dōu hé de lái, jiùshì yǐnshí xíguàn hé bù lái.
examples.english: He and I get along in personality and ideas, but it's just our eating habits that are incompatible.

items.wordHook: a 卩(seal) presses the page → 印(print).
Combining 國(country) and 中(middle): 國中 means junior high school.
A 田(field) 共(shared) by many is seen 異(different) by each.
Gathering spoken 言(speech) together to uphold moral 義(justice) guides leaders to 議(consult).
The open 土(earth) under a 龰(foot) → off to 走(walk) now.
